scope: VOICE, saved STANDARD queue IDs from the existing outbound snapshot, metric-level INITIATION_METHOD=OUTBOUND. This excludes API-origin and campaign-origin contacts unless explicitly shown in the separate campaign section.
campaign_period: Aug 27–28, 2026 ET; managed campaign NY-NL-1-1032-v2-08-27 only. No channel filter was used in this retained campaign request.
time_basis: Contact-record metrics follow historical disconnect-date reporting unless an explicit metric-specific exception applies. CONTACTS_HANDLED_CONNECTED_TO_AGENT_TIME uses agent-connection time; SUM_CONNECTING_TIME_AGENT is agent activity driven. CREATED attribution remains disputed by the Assistant; no created-minus-handled outcome cohort is certified.

warehouse.key: instance_id + metric_spec_hash + scope_hash + interval_start + interval_end + interval_period + dimensions_hash
warehouse.columns: metric_name, metric_filters_json, resource_filters_json, value, unit, start_utc, end_utc, timezone, dimensions_json, pulled_at, request_hash, raw_response
warehouse.joins: Join on all scope, interval, statistic, and dimension keys. Campaign rows must also retain campaign ARN; never join/add them to direct OUTBOUND as a partition.
warehouse.refresh: Upsert latest response by full key while retaining immutable raw-request/response audit history. Re-pull completed intervals for late records. Missing, error, and explicit zero are distinct.
warehouse.aggregate: Counts may sum across disjoint complete DAY intervals; native averages and rates may not. Multi-day totals use native TOTAL. Do not map API CONTACTS_CREATED to an unqualified count(*) of raw contact records.

metrics.label: Outbound legs created
metrics.meaning: Amazon-native created contact-leg count for the selected OUTBOUND queue scope. Not unique people reached, dial attempts across every origin, or proof of a human answer.

metrics.label: Outbound legs handled
metrics.meaning: Contact legs connected to an agent, reported at disconnect. Handled is agent workload; it does not prove the destination was a human rather than voicemail.

metrics.label: Created minus handled · provisional
metrics.meaning: Arithmetic reporting remainder only. Same filters do not establish a verified customer-not-answered population. Do not use as a reach-failure rate or callback list.

metrics.label: Customer disconnected
metrics.meaning: Handled OUTBOUND legs in Amazon's CUSTOMER_DISCONNECT category. One component of this period's handled disconnect breakdown.

metrics.label: Agent disconnected
metrics.meaning: Handled OUTBOUND legs in Amazon's AGENT_DISCONNECT category; not automatically an agent performance failure.

metrics.label: Third party disconnected
metrics.meaning: Handled OUTBOUND legs in Amazon's THIRD_PARTY_DISCONNECT category.

metrics.label: Other disconnect reason
metrics.meaning: Handled OUTBOUND legs assigned Amazon's OTHER filter category. Preserve original contact-record reason for investigation; not a custom forced balancing bucket.

metrics.label: Placed on hold
metrics.meaning: OUTBOUND contact legs placed on hold. Counts contacts, not number of hold events; queue wait is excluded.

metrics.label: Disconnected while on hold
metrics.meaning: Disconnects while on hold, including agent and customer disconnects. Do not label this exclusively customer abandonment.

metrics.label: Transferred out
metrics.meaning: OUTBOUND contact legs transferred out. The native definition can include queue transfers before agent connection; not necessarily a subset of handled contacts.

metrics.label: Average interaction time
metrics.meaning: Native average agent interaction duration for eligible OUTBOUND contacts. Excludes hold and after-contact work. Never average daily averages to form a period average.

metrics.label: Average after-contact work
metrics.meaning: Native average wrap-up duration. Amazon includes zero where a connected contact lacks a recorded after-contact-work duration; naive SQL AVG(nullable_duration) is not equivalent.

metrics.label: Total agent connecting time
metrics.meaning: Agent-reservation/connecting activity duration. Activity-time grain, not contact count, customer talk time, or a handled-contact denominator.

metrics.label: Handled · connection-time basis
metrics.meaning: Counts agent-connected contacts in the agent-connection timestamp interval. This is not a duration metric. It may differ from ordinary disconnect-timed CONTACTS_HANDLED at period boundaries.

metrics.label: Campaign send attempts
metrics.meaning: Send attempts for the separately identified campaign and Aug 27–28 interval. Attempts are not distinct recipients.

metrics.label: Campaign contacts connected
metrics.meaning: Agent-assisted campaign contacts connected to the system and eligible for abandonment calculations. With answering machine detection enabled, only HUMAN_ANSWERED is counted; when disabled, all connected contacts count. Not universally a human-answer count or an agent-handled count.

metrics.label: Campaign recipients targeted
metrics.meaning: Native targeted-recipient measure, separate from attempt and contact counts. Do not use these three measures as additive funnel components.

metrics.label: Campaign progress
metrics.meaning: Native recipients attempted divided by recipients targeted × 100. Available for segment-initiated campaigns, not event-triggered campaigns. Not the contact connection rate, success rate, or customer answer rate.

chart_rules: DAY values are native independent lines, not a same-contact funnel. Heat map preserves individual date/hour intervals, 24 hours ET; unreturned intervals remain unavailable. Queue ranking shows top six returned queues, not an exhaustive total. Disconnect bars are additive only when their sum equals same-scope handled. Hold/transfer series overlap and must not be stacked. Campaign measures have different grains and must not be stacked. Existing illustrative campaign 120 is not live data. All graph source links target this registry's dictionary entries.
